en: A black-and-white postcard image showing a large, ornate building with a steep, multi-windowed roof and a central tower, surrounded by trees and fields. The building has a sign labeled 'GENESUNGSHEIM' above the main entrance and architectural details typical of late 19th or early 20th century German-speaking regions. There is printed text at the bottom indicating the location.
